raw_provider_output.summary: Skittles addresses the London Pride event with a humorous, self-deprecating letter, acknowledging the shared use of the rainbow symbol and promising to stay out of the way while celebrating the occasion.

observations.description: The Skittles logo is displayed in the top left corner, accompanied by the tagline 'Give the Rainbow. Taste the Rainbow.' and the hashtag '#onerainbow'.
The main body of the ad is formatted as a letter beginning with the salutation 'Dear Pride in London,'.
The text of the letter is arranged in a diagonal, curved line that mimics the shape of a rainbow.
The copy uses a casual, self-deprecating tone, stating 'So this is kinda awkward' and referring to the brand's own rainbow as 'hunky-dory'.
The letter explicitly states the brand's intention to 'give up our rainbow' and 'stay out of the way' so that Pride can be the 'centre of attention'.
The letter concludes with a supportive message: 'Have a great day, Pride. From Skittles.'

claims.text: The brand is positioning itself as a respectful ally that recognizes the cultural significance of the rainbow to the LGBTQ+ community, prioritizing their celebration over its own marketing.
The diagonal layout of the text serves as a visual metaphor for the rainbow, reinforcing the central theme without using the brand's typical colorful packaging.
By adopting a self-deprecating and humble tone, the brand builds 'liking' and trust, avoiding the appearance of 'rainbow-washing' or co-opting the movement for profit.
The minimalist, black-and-white design of the letter contrasts with the usual vibrant Skittles branding, signaling a serious and respectful intent behind the message.
